rules.title: Return of Security Deposit and Itemized Statement Requirements
rules.requirement: The landlord must return the remainder of the security deposit to the tenant by personal delivery, check, or electronically if payments were made electronically, and provide an itemized statement of deductions with supporting documentation within a reasonable time after tenancy ends.
rules.summary_plain: When you move out, your landlord must return your security deposit promptly and provide a detailed list of any deductions with receipts or invoices.
rules.summary_plain_es: Cuando te mudes, tu arrendador debe devolverte el depósito de seguridad rápidamente y proporcionarte una lista detallada de cualquier deducción con recibos o facturas.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental units in California.
rules.exemptions_text: Exemptions include small deductions under $125 or if tenant waives rights in writing after proper notice.
rules.penalty: Landlord acting in bad faith may be liable for statutory damages up to twice the amount of the security deposit, plus actual damages.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord shall return the remainder of the security by personal delivery or by a check made payable to the tenant and mailed by first-class mail, postage prepaid... The landlord shall also include, along with and at the same time the itemized statement is sent, copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises... The bad faith claim or retention by a landlord or the landlord’s successors in interest of the security or any portion thereof in violation of this section... may subject the landlord or the landlord’s successors in interest to statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages.
